payload.name: recipe-fixed-ready-result
payload.description: Deterministic Tier-0 subworkflow that returns a fixed readiness result object. It assembles one orchestrator PythonCode step that assigns result = {"status": "Ready"} and returns that data. It does not post a user reply, change policy, write a file or dispatch any Tool. It is an unapproved draft: Q1 and human Q2 are required before activation, and the current Sempai sink cannot preserve this v3 Recipe constructor draft.

Q1 and human Q2 are required before this Recipe can be activated or reused. The subworkflow returns result only (a fixed readiness result object); it does not post a user reply, change policy, write a file or dispatch any Tool. The current Sempai sink cannot preserve this v3 Recipe constructor draft (it drops step_descriptions, variants and dependency_registry), so this export is an offline-design artifact, not a live submission.
